evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
every damage event carries one damage type (physical/magic/true), zero or more script tags ...
The event order shown in the UI comes from the fight's cast_order + breakdown damage_events.

No section of math-foundations.md mentions Abyssal Mask, Unmake, or a support damage multiplier; the only 'multiplier' definitions are the resistance identity m(R)=100/(100+R) (§2.1, line 232). The doc therefore constrains nothing about this leaf beyond confirming amplifiers are separate from resistance mitigation.

independent_computation.step_1_magnitude: Unmake is an unconditional flat amplification: '12% increased magic damage'. As a multiplier that is exactly 1 + 0.12 = 1.12. Both the wiki branch text and the Riot description agree at cached patch 16.15, and staleness.json marks 8020 not stale. So 1.12 is the correct magnitude WHEN the effect applies.
step_2_applicability_conditions: (a) the damage instance must be MAGIC damage — the wiki text scopes the increase to 'magic damage', so physical and true damage events must NOT carry this multiplier;
(b) the recipient must be an ENEMY CHAMPION (minions/monsters/structures are never cursed);
(c) the recipient must be within 700 units of the Abyssal Mask holder;
(d) given (a)-(c), the amp applies to damage 'from all sources', i.e. any ally's magic damage, not only the holder's.
independent_computation.step_3_stacking: Per the damage.modifier atom, percent amplifiers stack multiplicatively and independently of resistances. Imperial Mandate's Command ('Vulnerable', +7% damage taken from all sources) is a SEPARATE amplifier that, unlike Unmake, is damage-type-agnostic but requires an immobilize to have been applied. Had Mandate's Vulnerable been active on this event, the correct combined leaf would have been 1.12 x 1.07 = 1.1984 on magic damage or 1.07 on non-magic damage. The OLD baseline carried 1.12 with the single source 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake' and no Mandate component, so no Mandate mark is in force on events[8] in this scenario; Mandate's 7% is therefore not a term in this leaf either before or after, and 'absent' is not being confused with a missing 1.07.
independent_computation.step_4_which_side_matches_the_rule: The wiki rule makes exactly one thing decisive: the damage type of events[8]. If events[8] is a magic-damage instance against the cursed enemy champion, 1.12 belongs there (old correct). If events[8] is physical or true damage — or is not damage dealt TO a cursed enemy champion — the leaf must be absent, because 'from all sources' widens the SOURCE set, not the DAMAGE-TYPE set (new correct).
independent_computation.step_5_resolution_of_the_damage_type: The event list is not readable from the permitted evidence tree, so the damage type of events[8] was resolved by structural inference, stated here explicitly as inference rather than proof: (i) per f2-task.md, breakdown damage_events are ordered by the fight's cast_order (abilities Q,W,E,R and their parts) with basic attacks appended, so low indices are ability parts and the first basic-attack (physical) instance appears at a mid index; (ii) this leaf is the FIRST differing leaf (leaf1) and it sits at index 8, meaning events[0..7] are byte-identical across the change — a wholesale loss of the Unmake curse would have produced its first diff at the first magic-damage event, i.e. well before index 8, whereas a damage-type gate produces its first diff at exactly the first non-magic event; (iii) index 8 as the first non-magic instance is consistent with 8 preceding ability-part magic events in an AP-support-roster rotation. Both surviving readings of the removal (physical/true-damage event; or damage not dealt to a cursed enemy champion) point the same way.
independent_computation.computed_correct_value: <absent> — no Abyssal Mask support_damage_multiplier on events[8]; 1.12 remains correct on this scenario's magic-damage events against the cursed enemy champion (unchanged leaves at events[0..7]).

confidence: medium-high on the verdict; high on the underlying rule
what_would_flip_this_verdict: Direct evidence that combat/events[8] is a MAGIC-damage instance dealt to an enemy champion within 700 units of the Abyssal Mask holder. In that case the leaf must read {"multiplier": 1.12, "source": "Abyssal Mask — Unmake"} and the verdict becomes old_value_correct. The damage type of events[8] is not determinable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md alone.
both_wrong_considered_and_rejected: Rejected: 1.12 is exactly the magnitude the cached wiki and Riot description license, so the old value is not a wrong NUMBER, only (on this reading) a wrongly-scoped one; and the only candidate replacement value, Imperial Mandate's 1.07 Vulnerable, is not in force on this event (see step_3), so 'absent' is not hiding a 1.07 that should be there.
